summary: Eight-point configuration validated by direct reads, E5 bridge import/readback, reboot persistence, and decoded Loriot data. This evidence belongs to the tested configuration; it does not identify a newly attached instrument.
serial: Validated unit: slave 1, 19200 baud, 8N2. E5 bridge float order HL (low register word first).
help: Connect RS-485 to physical connector II. Side-label CH1 and CH2 describe analog outputs, not connectors I and II.
Do not run the USB-COMi-TB as a second master while the E5 bridge is an active master the same RS-485 bus.
Healthy fault and online status values are both 1. Error code 0 means no errors.
A table match confirms configuration correspondence only. Confirm the physical label, wiring, plausible measurements, and Loriot payload separately.

summary: Twelve-point documentation-derived test configuration. No physical HMD65 has been validated; this profile is not deployable.
serial: Candidate only: slave 1, 19200 baud, 8N1. Actual settings follow physical DIP switches. Float order HH is an unverified first candidate.
help: Suggested: confirm Modbus RTU mode, slave address, baud and parity from the HMD65 DIP settings (Vaisala M212264EN-B).
Suggested: prefer the documented float32 bank; metric starts at 1 and non-metric starts at 129. Addresses sent on the wire are one lower.
Suggested: check device and measurement status bitfields; error code occupies 514–515.
Suggested: confirm unit bank and word order against a known measurement before programming an E5 bridge profile.
